summary: Verified two bug fixes on Vendor Management app: (1) Bill numbering scheme AE####FY (temp) → BILL####FY (permanent primary key after final approval), and (2) NO footer/bottom workflow buttons on any page — all buttons in header TopActionBar. Complete 5-step bill E2E workflow reproduced (vendor AE0001JV2627 → bill AE00012627 → BILL00012627). Reports due-row uses permanent bill no; PV option label & voucher billRefNo both use BILL00012627.

issues: Placeholder text 'Generated on Final Approval' is truncated in the pill-generated input (visible 'Generated on Final App…'). Consider widening the field or reducing text.
React console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (hydration warning) from GST_SLABS/UOMs option rendering. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: (Cosmetic) Widen 'Permanent Bill No' pill or shorten placeholder to avoid truncation.
(Cosmetic) Fix hydration warning: extra <span> wrapper inside <option> elements in BillProcessing.jsx GST_SLABS/UOMs/etc.
critical_code_review_comments: store.js buildTempBillRef & buildPermanentBillNo both use the same billSerial counter — serials guaranteed identical across temp→permanent, verified: AE00012627 ↔ BILL00012627.

BillProcessing.jsx: BillProcessing component creates a fresh createBillDraft() on every mount, which increments billSerial each visit — this can leak serials if user navigates in/out without saving. Consider only allocating serial on first Save.
Reports.jsx still contains a `.bottom-actions` <div style={{display:'none'}}> placeholder with a hidden btn-prev-step — dead code, safe but should be removed for cleanliness.

handleSearch in BillProcessing uses findVendorByAny (only vendors) — search cannot load an existing saved bill by refNo/permanentBillNo (search placeholder promises 'Process ID / Bill No / Vendor Code'). Consider adding bill lookup.
seed_data_creation: Vendor TEST_ACME (AE0001JV2627) + bill (BILL00012627) seeded transiently in localStorage during test run
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bill workflow inputs are controlled by a stale-closure bind() in BillProcessing/VendorRegistration; using page.fill() rapidly between multi-step submits can appear to 'lose' onChange updates. Use el.press_sequentially(val, delay=50) for reliable typing. Verified numbering: refNo=AE{serial}{FY}, permanentBillNo=BILL{serial}{FY} at step 5. Reports due-row testid = due-row-{permanentBillNo}. PV voucher billRefNo uses permanentBillNo || refNo.
rca of the issue: N/A – both requested bug fixes pass. No action items besides two cosmetic/console cleanups.
